title: Local Darwin libusb target ignores patched backend source
summary: Missing source prerequisites allow an existing normal build to keep the old libusb backend required by the restored auto-detach path.
evidence: quality-review.md and verification.md; forced-newer source dry-run now selects rebuild/install.

resolution.evidence: Task verification.md, quality-review.md and security.md; 36/36 fake USB and ASan/UBSan tests, baseline rollback failure reproduced, normal build dependency dry-run verified. Physical device restoration remains unverified.
